title: AML Knowledge Base Definition
description: Compiled JSON payload for an AML knowledge base definition (.kb.md). Validates that the compiled output conforms to the AML v1.2 specification.

spec_version.title: Spec Version
spec_version.description: AML format version. Must equal a platform-approved version string.

kb_id.title: KB ID
kb_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for this knowledge base. Lowercase kebab-case. Immutable once any agent references it in a published definition.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic version of this KB definition. Major bump required for complete content restructuring or URI changes.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. draft=not usable in production; active=usable; deprecated=usable but lint warning; disabled=hard compile error on reference.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Descriptive metadata for this knowledge base.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for this knowledge base.

description.title: Description
description.description: Two to four sentences describing the content, scope, and intended use of this KB.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team responsible for the content and maintenance of this knowledge base.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Searchable labels for discovery and filtering.

last_updated.title: Last Updated
last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last update to this KB definition.

source.title: Source
source.description: Storage and location configuration for this knowledge base.

type.title: Type
type.description: Storage type: vector_index=dense vector index; vector_store=managed vector store with metadata filtering; document_set=flat document collection; sql_table=relational table; api=external API; graph_db=graph database; hybrid_store=combined dense vector and keyword index.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: Stable, platform-resolved address the runtime uses to query this KB. Use the kb:// scheme for platform-managed stores. Immutable once registered.

freshness_window_days.title: Freshness Window Days
freshness_window_days.description: Content older than this number of days may be considered stale. Required (lint warning if absent) for time-sensitive domains.

index_refresh.title: Index Refresh
index_refresh.description: How often the index is rebuilt (e.g., 'every-6h', 'daily'). Infrastructure concern — does not affect runtime behavior.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Content boundary declaration for this knowledge base. Defines what topics are in and out of scope.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Primary content domains covered by this KB (e.g., 'product_features', 'api_usage').

include.title: Include
include.description: Explicit list of content types or topics included in this KB.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Explicit list of content types or topics excluded from this KB.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: BCP 47 language codes of content available in this KB.

version_coverage.title: Version Coverage
version_coverage.description: Which product versions are covered: 'current'=latest only; 'all'=all versions; 'range:<from>-<to>'=specific range.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Trust and data sensitivity classification for this knowledge base.

trust_level.title: Trust Level
trust_level.description: authoritative=primary source of truth; supplemental=supporting reference; unverified=content not yet validated.

data_classification.title: Data Classification
data_classification.description: Data sensitivity and compliance properties of the content in this KB.

contains_pii.title: Contains PII
contains_pii.description: If true, this KB contains personally identifiable information. Affects access control and audit requirements.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Compliance frameworks applicable to the content in this KB (e.g., 'GDPR', 'HIPAA', 'SOC2').

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidentiality level: public=no restrictions; internal=company employees only; confidential=need-to-know basis; restricted=highest sensitivity.

retrieval_defaults.title: Retrieval Defaults
retrieval_defaults.description: Default retrieval parameters for this KB. Agent-level overrides may tighten but not loosen these defaults.

search_mode.title: Search Mode
search_mode.description: Default retrieval strategy: keyword=BM25-style; semantic=vector similarity; hybrid=combined.

max_chunks.title: Max Chunks
max_chunks.description: Default maximum number of chunks returned per retrieval call.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Default maximum token budget for retrieved content.

result_granularity.title: Result Granularity
result_granularity.description: Granularity of returned results: chunk=passage-level; section=section-level; document=full document.

reranking.title: Reranking
reranking.description: If true, retrieved results are reranked by a cross-encoder before being returned.

citation_preference.title: Citation Preference
citation_preference.description: required=agents must cite; optional=citations encouraged; none=citations not needed.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate
deduplicate.description: If true, near-duplicate chunks are deduplicated before being returned.

min_score.title: Min Score
min_score.description: Minimum relevance score threshold (0.0–1.0). Chunks below this score are excluded.

retrieval.title: Retrieval
retrieval.description: Usage guidance for the model. Tells the model when to query and when to avoid this KB.

use_when.title: Use When
use_when.description: Conditions under which the model should retrieve from this KB.

avoid_when.title: Avoid When
avoid_when.description: Conditions under which the model should not retrieve from this KB.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description: Freshness policy for this KB. Controls how the runtime handles stale content.

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: Content older than this number of days is considered stale.

on_stale.title: On Stale
on_stale.description: Action when content exceeds the freshness window: warn=log a warning but continue; refuse=refuse to retrieve; fallback=use fallback_kb instead.

fallback_kb.title: Fallback KB
fallback_kb.description: KB ID to use instead when this KB is stale. Only relevant when on_stale=fallback.

last_verified.title: Last Verified
last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date when the content was last verified as current.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Compiled from the Markdown body of the .kb.md file. Sections are optional but validated when present.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Compiled from the optional '# Purpose' section. Why this KB exists and what agents should use it for.

content_coverage.title: Content Coverage
content_coverage.description: Compiled from the optional '# Content coverage' section. Detailed description of what content is and is not included.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Compiled from the optional '# Notes' section. Miscellaneous guidance for authors and reviewers.

aml_id.title: AML ID
aml_id.description: Stable, immutable AML identifier. Lowercase kebab-case or snake_case. Must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,64}$.
